purpose: Teach: ウイング/システムズ/サイボウズ/光文社/ウンコ/丸出し/細木/小田急

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがサッカーのウイング、つまりウインガーのプレー集を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's watching a compilation of winger plays in soccer.
lines.style: Light, informative tone with a gentle smile underneath. Soft delivery as if sharing a small, familiar domestic detail. Warm acknowledgment of her husband's habits.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとIT企業のシステムズ系のオフィス見学行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to see an IT company's office with Dad—the systems division.
lines.style: Bright, eager voice bouncing slightly on the important words. Clear pride in what he's witnessed. Quick pace, genuine excitement without being performative.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがサイボウズの紹介動画を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's watching an introduction video about Cybozu.
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. A slight knowing quality—she's noticing the pattern. Still warm but with a hint of quiet amusement at her husband's interests.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと光文社の児童書読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I read a children's book from Kobunsha together.
lines.style: Bright and earnest, with a sense of shared accomplishment. Medium pace, clear articulation on the book publisher name. Genuine pleasure in the shared activity.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「『ウンコ漢字ドリル』は子供に大人気」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was saying that the 'Unko Kanji Drill' is incredibly popular with kids.
lines.style: Warm, amused delivery with light quotation marks in the voice. Slight laugh behind the words—she's sharing her husband's comment with gentle humor. Relaxed, natural pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「お腹を丸出しに寝ない様」教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me not to sleep with my belly exposed.
lines.style: Sincere and earnest, as if reporting something genuinely important he's learned. Respectful tone toward the lesson received. Steady pacing, clear and direct.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが細木数子の占い特集を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's watching a special about fortune teller Hosoki Kazuko.
lines.style: Gentle observation with sustained warmth. A knowing patience in the delivery—she's accepting yet another of her husband's eclectic interests. Soft, steady pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと小田急ロマンスカーで箱根行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I took the Odakyu Romance Car to Hakone!
lines.style: Bright, excited close with genuine joy radiating through. A touch of breathlessness on the place name. Quick pace that slows slightly at the end in satisfaction. Warm and present.
